candidate.definition_en: A person who campaigns to bring about political or social change.
candidate.explanation_ar: شخص ناشط بيتحرك وبيطالب بحقوق أو تغيير في المجتمع، مش بيسكت على الغلط.

senses.definition_en: A person who campaigns to bring about political or social change.
senses.explanation_ar: شخص ناشط يعمل على إحداث تغيير سياسي أو اجتماعي.
examples: He is a well-known human rights activist.
As an environmental activist, she spoke out against the construction of the new chemical plant.
The local community rallied behind the activist during the public hearing.
